reason: Iron and stone seem useful for making the chisel needed for the current goal.

effect: The irrigation channel reached the supported garden, completing the final goal and the chapter.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the water route reach the garden as expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the saw was most worthwhile because the explanation of its sharpened, outward-set teeth gave the construction a useful physical detail.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the water channel felt less informative because the planks' role was left unclear.

surprise.text: The saw and wood produced a pipe by cutting a log and boring out its center; I had not anticipated the boring step.

arbitrary.text: Combining the pipe with planks made a water channel, but the result did not explain how the planks were used.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: assembling the water-lifting system was satisfying, and the explanations of the tools added some interest.
